chunks: Surely their Lord will be aware of their (deeds).
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's knowledge of human deeds on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Mutaffifin, this verse underscores Allah's absolute awareness of the deceitful practices of those who cheat in measurement, serving as a divine counterpoint to their self-deception. Shia exegetes highlight this as a guarantee of precise retribution, where no hidden nuance of intent or action escapes His judgment, reinforcing the concept of 'Adl (Divine Justice).
